name: Stunts Support
description: Drives the tracks and cars of a Stunts install, read straight from the game's own files

launch_options.label: Stunts directory
launch_options.help: The folder holding STUNTS.EXE and its .TRK files.

launch_options.label: Track
launch_options.help: Any .TRK in that folder; case does not matter.

launch_options.label: Car
launch_options.help: Any CAR*.RES in that folder; its own engine figures drive.

grid.explanation: Every track is a 1802-byte file: a 30x30 grid of road tile ids, the same grid of terrain ids, then a horizon byte and a flags byte.

scale.explanation: The files carry no unit, so a cell is given a size that makes a stock lap run to about the length the game's own lap times imply.

tile_table.explanation: Tile ids are opaque. tools/make_tile_table.py derives what each id connects to from which neighbours are occupied wherever it appears, across every track in an install.

cars.fields: gear count, performance index, idle rpm, peak-power rpm, red line, rev limit
cars.explanation: Cross-checked against the showroom text in the same archive, which quotes each car's real power and top speed.

import_notes: This package reads an existing Stunts installation at run time and ships none of its data. Point STUNTS_DIR at your own copy.
